title: Norwegian Butternut Squash Casserole
description: A warm and comforting Norwegian-inspired casserole made with roasted butternut squash, nourishing ingredients, and a crispy topping.
instructions: Peel, de-seed, and chop the butternut squash into 1-inch cubes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, milk, salt, and black pepper. Stir until smooth.
Add the chopped butternut squash to the bowl and mix until well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the oats and shredded cheese.
Sprinkle the oat and cheese mixture evenly over the top of the casserole.
Dot the top of the casserole with unsalted butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown and the squash is tender.
